raw_segments.text: Poor Miss Amelia was accustomed to being called a goose.
She knew, in fact, that she was rather a goose, and that it was left to geese to do a great
It was a somewhat embarrassing thing to go into the midst of a room full of delighted
children and tell the giver of the feast that she had suddenly been transformed into a little
beggar, and must go upstairs and put on an old black frock which was too small for her.
But the thing must be done.
This was evidently not the time when questions might be asked.
